title: The Summer of the Crescent Cove
author: Marguerite Eriksen
blurb: Ulyana Quintana, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade before the bakery lease runs out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
